en.description: Turn a user-supplied club-activity script and authorized stills into one club activity talking clip per still. This club notice talking video studio writes a speakable event script talking clip for each photo, then animates a 2 to 15s club notice talking clip. Use it for club activity talking pack, club signup talking clip, and activity notice talking pack work that stays one photo, one clip.
en.summary: Turn a user-supplied club-activity script and authorized stills into one club activity talking clip per still.
en.title: Club Activity Talking Clips: One Still, One Event Script Read
